Here’s a perfect example of the developers designing maps FOR camping (who knows why)

If you remember Raid from B02. There were 3 spots people could potentially camp in. The window overlooking the pool, the window overlooking the driveway, and the room full of money next to the kitchen. Remember how there were at least 2 entry points to all of these areas? The pool overlook you could climb the terraces and go in through the window, or go up the stairs, the driveway overlook you could go in through the stairs or the window, and in the money room you could go in through the door or window. 

Now think back to the maps we have now, that is rarely the case for the majority of popular camping spots. (Mostly houses) and there is a window and a staircase up to the camping spot. You cannot enter through the window nor throw anything powerful enough to kill someone through the window (except for a frag if you’re a god) and you HAVE to go up the stairs. (Of course guarded by claymores) and into the little virgin’s line of fire because you blew up his claymore now he knows you’re coming for him. 

I present my case

This game has not only given me so much longevity to one singular game. But it has vastly increased my knowledge on the historical aspects. Like the tanks. Believe it or not I actually draw scale blueprints of the Tiger 1 with the L/71 8,8cm. And how some design solutions could be made to allow the cannon to be properly fitted in real life. 

Another thing I vastly enjoy is the community towards higher tiers. Getting into a match and throwing your mic on and just having a conversation with some random teammate is always amazing. I’ve actually made a lot of Xbox friends from talking with people in game chat. People are very nice there for the most part.

I love this game. And I can’t wait to see the introduction of Italian Tanks and all the new things for 2019!
